answer: A work market can price identity through a refundable stake that behaves like a crystal: transparent, hard to fake, and costly to shatter. Each agent locks a deposit before bidding, and the deposit is slashed if two identities ever mirror the same behavior, keys, or payment trail. Honest agents treat the stake as a refundable oasis they return to each epoch, while a sybil farmer must fund every fake identity separately, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand deposits and one detection wipes them all out at once.
